items.title: Ray Vega interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 20, 2023
items.q: Stan Getz. ... Stan Getz played by ear. ... how do I explain how Stan Getz can play on all of those Chick Corea tunes on that recording “Captain Marvel” when he didn’t know how to read chord changes.

ctx.x: I’ve insisted that there’s a magic to improvisation, to jazz improvisation that’s not really explainable but that is a problem I think in the world of education because you can’t teach a four year program on jazz without getting into the codifying of it. I mean how are you going to adjust —

How do you apply it? Well codifying, how do you explain it all, and how do you put it into words? The problem here I would say is that many of the academics that are coming out here right now understand the math of it but they’ve never put a set list together in Europe trying to figure out who — well the heck with Europe, I’ve done that enough times, I’m talking about they haven’t even done a local gig looking into the audience and going okay we’ve got to play this, let’s try this, let’s read the audience.…
